datasheet.title: 7050X4 Series 100/200/400G Data Center Switches Data Sheet (Arista Networks, 03-0057-27, Aug 27th, 2025)

description: Arista 7050CX4M-48D8 - a fixed 2RU data-centre switch with 48 x 100G QSFP28 ports, 8 x 400G QSFP-DD ports and 2 x SFP+ ports, with MACsec, running EOS. The front carries the QSFP28 cages in four rows of twelve columns, in two halves of two rows with a grille between them, three blocks of two columns (six columns) on each side. The eight QSFP-DD cages are four stacked columns between the left and right QSFP28 blocks. The two SFP+ cages are stacked at the right, under the management block, which holds the RJ-45 management port, the USB port and the RJ-45 console port, with the four system lamps (system, fan, PS1, PS2) beside it. The rear carries two hot-swap power supplies stacked at the right, four hot-swap fan modules, and an earth grounding pad. The same panel is ordered with front-to-rear air (-F) or rear-to-front air (-R).

name: 7050cx4m-48d8

chassis.note: Guide Table 1: 48.3 x 8.8 x 66.8 cm (19 x 3.50 x 26.3 inches), 16.0 kg (35.1 lbs). Data sheet: 43.99 x 8.79 x 66.8 cm (17.3 x 3.46 x 26.30 in), 35.1 lbs (16.0 kg). The width: 48.3 cm is over the mounting ears, so the body between them, which is what is modelled, is the data sheet's 43.99 cm (440.0 here). The height is the data sheet's 87.9 (the guide rounds it to 8.8 cm). The depth is the guide's 66.8 cm (668.0), the data sheet's figure too. 2RU.

colour.note: The front plate is the median of bare-plate pixels in the guide's figure C-7.

configurations.note: Data sheet ordering information: DCS-7050CX4M-48D8-F and -R ("MACsec, front-to-rear air, 2xAC" and "MACsec, rear-to-front air, 2xAC"). The "#" SKU is an order of parts. The data sheet lists no DC SKU: the DC configurations are examples with no part number. The 7050CX4M-48D8 has no non-MACsec sibling in the guide, so it is a device of its own with MACsec as a property of every build.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED. The guide's Chapter 3 mounts the 2RU switch with the KIT-7201 or KIT-7202 brackets in Figures 3-9 to 3-17, isometric drawings that carry no measure; the guide's Appendix B lists the kits KIT-7201 and KIT-7202 and the ground kit KIT-GND-EXT-2RU, and the data sheet the spare KIT-7201. No figure measures a bracket position and the kit guides are not held, so no ear position is written and no rail kit is listed in chassis.kits. Recorded in the gap rack-ears.

environment.note: Guide Table 2: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -25 to 70 C, altitude 0 to 3,000 m, humidity 5 to 90 percent non-condensing. Data sheet: storage -40 to 70 C. The storage temperature differs: gap `environment`, the guide's used.

front-legend.note: The figure prints the maker's wordmark at the top left from 6.4 to 28.7 mm across and 3.0 to 6.6 mm down, and the model "7050CX4M-48D8" in small type under it. THE WORDMARK IS NOT DRAWN: a logo-zone region is reserved over it and the plain model text is set.

front-ports.note: Figure C-7 at 1.882 px/mm anchored on the 440 mm body, tab centres from a pixel scan. Forty-eight QSFP28 cages (ports 1 to 48) in four rows and twelve columns: two rows above the QSFP-DD zone's middle and two below, each pair of rows with a grille between, in blocks of two columns on a 19.0 mm pitch (the registry's ganged QSFP pitch) with 9.7 mm more between blocks, three blocks of two columns (six columns) across each half row. The first column is centred 21.3 mm from the left and the seventh 277.9 mm; the block spacing is 47.7 mm. The rows centre 31.6, 47.6, 61.2 and 76.8 mm below the top. Ports 1 to 24 are the upper pair of rows, odd numbers on top, 25 to 48 the lower; the left six columns hold ports 1 to 12 and 25 to 36 and the right six 13 to 24 and 37 to 48. Eight QSFP-DD cages (49 to 56) in four stacked columns, the first centred 165.0 mm from the left on a 27.9 mm pitch, rows 47.6 and 61.2 mm below the top; they are 19.0 x 10.0 mm (std/qsfp-dd). Two SFP+ cages (57 over 58) at the right, centred 418.9 mm from the left, 61.4 and 76.3 mm down. The belly-to-belly orientation is the library's convention (upper cage upright, lower turned 180); the figure is too small to show the latch side.

fru-bays.note: Guide Appendix E and the data sheet ("1+1 hot-swappable"): THE TWO POWER SUPPLIES AND THE FOUR FAN MODULES ARE BAYS. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit. The guide draws no blank for an empty bay, so none is modelled. The earth grounding pad is part of the chassis and is a placement.

gate-1-front.note: Figure C-7 passes at 0.5 percent. The raster is 848 x 317 pixels. The body between its plate edges measures 828 px wide and 166 px tall (aspect 4.99), against the data sheet's 439.9 / 87.9 = 5.00, so the figure is near-orthographic and carries geometry at 1.882 px/mm (the 440 mm body is the scale anchor). One pixel is 0.53 mm, so every front position is good to about 0.5 mm, and every one is `estimated` because it is read off a picture and no dimension states it. The cage columns were read from the white port-number tabs by their centres.

gate-1-rear.note: Figure D-2 passes within 2 mm: the raster is 565 px wide, the chassis 525 px between its edges (1.193 px/mm over the 440 mm body) and 104 px tall (87.2 mm against 87.9). The positions below are the same as arista/7280dr3a-36's, whose guide draws the same four-fan 2RU rear at the same 1.193 px/mm, and agree with this figure to within two millimetres. The guide draws the rear generically (D-1 and D-2) and does not say which model uses which. The 7050CX4M-48D8 is mapped to D-2 by its four fan modules (data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 4 (N+1 redundant)"), its 2RU height and its two stacked power supplies, and the figure's "Earth grounding pad" matches guide Table 6 (attach directly at the rear). THE MAPPING IS ESTIMATED.

interface-names.note: Not printed and not modelled. The guide's configuration example names "interface management 1".

lifecycle.note: Searched 2026-10-22 for an end-of-sale notice for the 7050CX4M-48D8 on Arista's advisories and notices pages. No notice was found.

management-block.note: Figure C-7 callouts 2, 3 and 4: the Ethernet management port, the USB port and the console port (serial) are stacked in a framed block at the top right of the front, 410.2 to 427.4 mm across and 18.0 to 50.2 mm down: the management jack on top, the USB port in the middle and the console jack at the bottom. The figure draws the jacks about 13.6 mm wide and 9.5 mm tall; the registry's jack is 15.8 x 13.2 and is seated, which fills the frame. The symbols beside them (a double arrow over the management jack, a USB symbol, a console symbol) are drawn as read.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. Each carries an `empty` sentence. Guide Table 6 says the 2RU 7050CX4M-48D8 attaches its ground directly, a right-angle lug recommended; the earth grounding pad is on the rear (Figure D-2, callout 7).

port-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.2, Table 10: off the link is down, green link up, yellow software disabled, flashing yellow failed diagnostics. Figure C-7's callout 9 "Port status LED" points at the ribbed strip along the lower lip and at the strip legends, and resolves no lamp beside the 48 QSFP28 cages. NO QSFP28 PORT LAMP IS DRAWN (the gap `port-lamps`). The QSFP-DD cages show a small dark mark at the lower left of an upper cage and the upper right of a lower one, drawn as one lamp each, and the SFP+ cages two green triangles between them (up for 57, down for 58), drawn as one lamp each.

port-numbering.note: Figure C-7 (callout 1, "Port numbers") prints 1 over 2, 3 over 4, and so on across the upper pair of rows, 1 to 24, then 25 over 26 and so on across the lower, 25 to 48, then 49 over 50 to 55 over 56 in the QSFP-DD columns and 57 over 58 for the SFP+ cages. The odd number is the upper cage of each pair. The figure prints each number on a white tab over its cage and, smaller, in the coloured strip above each pair of rows, an up arrow after an odd number and a down arrow after an even one. The QSFP28 numerals are set in the strip; the QSFP-DD and SFP+ numerals in blue beside the cage. EOS interface names are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

power.note: Guide Table 4: typical / maximum 390 W / 740 W with PWR-1512-AC or PWR-1511-DC; the data sheet states the same, typical "measured at 25C ambient with 50% load on all ports, excludes transceivers".

rear.note: Figure D-2, the rear seen from behind with x = 0 at the left of the drawing, as arista/7280dr3a-36: the four fan modules 79.6 mm wide at 5.9, 103.9, 189.4 and 274.9 mm across and 3.2 mm down, a grey strip 15.0 mm wide at 87.2 mm carrying the earth grounding pad (callout 7), and the two power supply modules 73.5 mm wide at 361.0 mm across, 2.0 and 45.0 mm down. PS1 is the upper (callout 5) and PS2 the lower (callout 6).

rear-fan.note: Data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 4 (N+1 redundant)", "Fan Tray FAN-7012H-RED / FAN-7012H-BLUE" for the 7050CX4M-48D8, spares FAN-7012H-RED and FAN-7012H-BLUE. The guide's appendix D says "Handle or bezel color indicates airflow direction". The four fan modules are bays that accept those two; the -R configurations seat the blue ones.
